messages:
rachel: heads-up: console shows a p99 spike for /generate in ap-south starting ~14:10 UTC. p50/p95 look steady, p99 ~3x for a short window.

omar: saw that on the overlay. any caller_tag/transport breakout?

mira: ran a quick slice: transport=websocket p50=140ms p95=180ms p99=2100ms count=8; transport=http p50=85ms p95=110ms p99=120ms count=1240.

omar: yep merging websocket+http rollups without transport in the rollup key will produce a phantom tail when websocket has tiny high-tail samples.

jake: short-term mitigation: UI should show a tiny badge next to p99 with "samples: N per-slice" and a "split by" control (transport, stream flag). avoids confusing customers.

mira: agreed. I'll file EP-9001 to add sample-count badges + split-by transport and to update runbook. also propose defaulting rollup key to include transport for endpoints that support both.

omar: long-term: either include transport in rollup key or add a merge-guard that refuses to merge low-count slices into large rollups.

rachel: can we toggle the aliasing flag for the canary while we patch the UI? I'd like to stop the noise for the next hour.

deploy-bot: Feature-flag change requested: alias-endpoint-transport -> OFF for canary cohort at 14:22 UTC.

mira: requerying panels now, p99 collapsed back to baseline for /generate in ap-south. leaving EP-9001 and a dashboard annotation for the canary window.

jake: also adding alert rule suggestion: fire when p99 > p95 * 4 for a slice AND sample_count >= 10 to avoid chasing 1-off noise.

rachel: perfect. thanks all. will close the transient incident once the canary window finishes and the annotation is visible.
